question: Related Questions Q. Assalamoalaikum. My parents are after me about my beard. answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 63285 Country: India Title: Speaking in bathroom Question: Is speaking in bathroom or latrine allowed in any condition? Answer ID: 63285 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 437/525/L=05/1437) It is mustahab not to talk in the toilet as the satr is open there. However, one may have short talk when needed. ويستحب أن لا يتكلم بکلام مطلقا ؛ أما كلام الناس فلكراهته حال الكشف (شامى 1/ 291 مطلب : سنن الغسل) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
